title: International debut
description: Made his India debut in ODI cricket against Ireland in Belfast.

title: IPL begins
description: Started his IPL career with Deccan Chargers.

title: 264 at Kolkata
description: Set the men's ODI record for the highest individual score with 264 against Sri Lanka.

title: Third ODI double century
description: Scored 208* against Sri Lanka in Mohali.

title: Historic World Cup
description: Scored 648 runs and five centuries at the Cricket World Cup.

title: Khel Ratna
description: Received the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna, now named the Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna.

title: World Cup captaincy
description: Led India through an unbeaten group stage and into the 2023 World Cup final.

title: T20 World Cup champion
description: Captained India to the 2024 T20 World Cup title and retired from T20Is after the final.

title: Test retirement & Champions Trophy
description: Retired from Test cricket in May 2025 and captained India to the Champions Trophy title.

title: ODI chapter continues
description: Continued representing India in ODIs during 2026, including series against Afghanistan and England.
